values.note: Camping May 1-October 31, weather permitting; the cabins are open all year.

Some full-hookup sites book per site on MyCountyParks, the rest and all primitive sites are first come, first served. Online booking closes 3 days before arrival; an unoccupied site with no reserved tag may then be taken. 4-night minimum over Memorial Day, the 4th of July and Labor Day. Reservations are final and non-refundable.

note: Cherokee County Conservation's 300-acre Little Sioux River valley area, 13 mi northeast of Cherokee off C16. South Gate modern loop: 60-ft back-in full-hookup sites with cement patios, new shower house and playground. North Gate: four primitive areas with water pumps and vault toilets. Horse trails and a canoe access. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $30 modern ($10 primitive), 50-amp full hookups, showers, partly reservable. Added 40 sites, flush/vault toilets, dump, Wi-Fi, May 1-Oct 31 season, 14-night max, holiday 4-night minimum, 3-day booking cutoff. Not waterfront stands. Phone found: 712-225-6709.
flags: PHONE MISSING: Cherokee County Conservation 712-225-6709 (cherokeeccb@gmail.com), posted on the Martin's Access facility pages.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands for the modern loop. NAIP shows it in a wooded side valley; the Little Sioux (~35-50 m wide) is ~450 m west through timber, with no sightline. The four primitive North Gate areas lie along the river valley to the north and west but are tent/primitive with water pumps, with no stated RV fit, so I did not chase a river value for them.

RESERVABLE COUNT: the camping page says '8 reservable', the modern-campground page '6 reservable full service campsites', and MyCountyParks lists 7 (sites 3, 5, 6, 8, 14, 15, 16). Booking note says 'some' rather than a number.

PRIMITIVE COUNT: the park page says 'three primitive camping areas with a total of 40 campsites, 16 full service'; the camping page says 16 modern + 24 primitive in 4 areas. Wrote 40 total from the camping page.
min_stay 'applies: holiday' covers the three named holiday weekends. Pin OK (on the South Gate loop). Two addresses posted: 4594 Martin Access Rd (South Gate) and 629 River Road (office).
